glossary.definition: (1) "Claimant" means a person to whom an agricultural commodity handler owes a financial obligation for agricultural commodities or the actual monetary proceeds from agricultural commodities that have been delivered to the handler.
glossary.source_title: Section 926.021 - Lien on agricultural commodity assets of failed agricultural commodity handler.
